entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: A legendary, battered spacecraft in the Edge, crewed by Sami and Tannuk.

entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Human captain and engineer of the Seriema.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Kav pilot and first mate of the Seriema.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Forces the Seriema evaded on Kavaron.

entities.name: Kavaron

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: Led the Illvoi mechanics who repaired the Seriema's fusion drive.

events.summary: While evading Sunstar Free Company forces on Kavaron, the Seriema's radar is smashed and its main drive nozzle lasered off.
events.quote: her radar was smashed and the magnet nozzle for her main drive was lasered off

events.summary: Illvoi mechanics under Mm'menon repair the Seriema's fusion drive.
events.quote: Her fusion drive was subsequently repaired by Illvoi mechanics under Mm'menon
